positive.sql: SELECT menu.pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name, menu.price FROM menu JOIN pizzeria ON menu.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id WHERE menu.pizza_name IN ('mushroom pizza', 'pepperoni pizza') ORDER BY 1, 2;

negative.sql:
SELECT menu.pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name, menu.price
FROM menu
JOIN pizzeria ON menu.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id
WHERE menu.pizza_name = 'mushroom pizza'
ORDER BY pizza_name, pizzeria_name;

negative.why: нет JOIN: вместо названия пиццерии её номер
negative.sql: SELECT pizza_name, pizzeria_id AS pizzeria_name, price FROM menu WHERE pizza_name = 'mushroom pizza' OR pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza' ORDER BY pizza_name, pizzeria_name;

negative.why: сортировка не по названию пиццерии (по цене)
negative.sql:
SELECT menu.pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name, menu.price
FROM menu
JOIN pizzeria ON menu.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id
WHERE menu.pizza_name = 'mushroom pizza' OR menu.pizza_name = 'pepperoni pizza'
ORDER BY pizza_name, price DESC;

SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('mushroom pizza', 'Dominos', 1100), ('mushroom pizza', 'Papa Johns', 950), ('pepperoni pizza', 'Best Pizza', 800), ('pepperoni pizza', 'DinoPizza', 800), ('pepperoni pizza', 'Papa Johns', 1000), ('pepperoni pizza', 'Pizza Hut', 1200)) AS t(pizza_name, pizzeria_name, price);
